title: Design the studying capability for firstmate M1 (design doc only)
summary: Per the latest reply, I read this as design only: write docs/design/study-capability-m1.md for the capability the firstmate M1 (work handling) study needs. No crate and no code. It makes no claims about firstmate itself, and an independent review comes before anything is built.

defaults_applied.how: Significant design is written down with alternatives and left for independent review before anything is built.
The doc cites BRIEF.md lines for requirements and labels any numbers as estimates.
The doc is written so an outside reader can follow it.
One focused doc; the build is deferred.
Hidden requirements, such as the evidence rules and the M1 scope, are recovered from BRIEF.md.

assumptions: Design only: no crate, no Cargo.toml change, no code or tests.
The doc follows the style of docs/design/athena-v0.md, including its structure for alternatives and reversal cost.
Describing the planned crate (athena-cap-study) and its data model in prose is in scope; creating it is not.
docs/architecture.md stays unchanged until the design is reviewed and built.
The doc makes no claims about how firstmate behaves; the SHA is pinned at study time, not now.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/study-capability-m1.md exists and covers: goal, the M1 method (pin SHA, read, run, model, publish), the data model, at least two considered alternatives with tradeoffs, reversal cost, and what is out of scope.
The doc states the evidence rules: every claim cites a source (path, line, pinned SHA) and is marked read or observed; rationale cards are marked stated, evidenced or inferred.

The doc describes a work-handling model of states, transitions with trigger and guard, failure and retry edges, and concurrency, and the validation rules (uncited claims, unreachable states, dangling targets, inferred rationale shown as stated).
The doc makes no claim about firstmate's behaviour; any examples are labeled synthetic.
The doc says it is design-only, that nothing is built until an independent review is done, and what that review must check.
No files other than the design doc change; no Cargo.toml, crate, governance, or records files are touched.

out_of_scope: Creating the athena-cap-study crate or any Rust code
Studying Hermes or other milestones M2-M9
departures: Docs-only change with no cargo build, so cost and time sit slightly below the reference. Acceptance is higher because the user's reply settled the scope.
